title: Unit 2 第四课时 基础达标与综合拓展

sections.title: 一、语音练习
sections.instruction: 按照音标写出单词，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出正确的一项。

questions.prompt: 1. You look really like my handsome ______ /'ɡræntʃaɪld/.
questions.translation: 你看起来真像我英俊的孙子/孙女。
questions.explanation: 音标 /'ɡræntʃaɪld/ 对应的单词是单数名词grandchild（孙子；孙女；外孙；外孙女）。故选 grandchild。

questions.prompt: 2. Sometimes they would ______ /haɪk/ in the forest.
questions.translation: 有时他们会在森林里远足。
questions.explanation: 音标 /haɪk/ 对应的单词是动词hike（远足，徒步旅行）。故选 hike。

questions.prompt: 3. The father often plays football with his ______ /sʌn/ at the park.
questions.translation: 这位父亲经常在公园和他的儿子一起踢足球。
questions.explanation: 音标 /sʌn/ 对应家庭成员名词son（儿子）；sun意为“太阳”。故选 son。

questions.prompt: 4. She loves all her ______ /'ɡrænˌtʃɪldrən/, but Mary is her favourite.
questions.translation: 她疼爱她所有的孙辈，但玛丽是她最喜欢的。
questions.explanation: 音标 /'ɡrænˌtʃɪldrən/ 对应名词复数grandchildren（孙子孙女们）。故选 grandchildren。

sections.title: 二、用方框内所给单词的适当形式填空
sections.instruction: 根据句意，从方框中选择恰当的单词并用其适当形式填空。

questions.prompt: 1. This is my ______ Peter. He is my father's brother.
questions.translation: 这是我的叔叔彼得。他是我父亲的兄弟。
questions.explanation: father's brother意为父亲的兄弟，即uncle（叔叔/伯父）。故选 uncle。

questions.translation: 这里有两件绿色的夹克衫。
questions.explanation: 倒装句型Here are...意为“这里有……”。句首首字母大写。故选 here。

questions.translation: 我叔叔的女儿是我的堂妹。
questions.explanation: uncle's daughter意为叔叔的女儿，即cousin（堂姐妹）。故选 cousin。

questions.prompt:
4. —Is she your father's sister?
—Yes, she is my ______.
questions.translation:
——她是你的姑姑（父亲的姐妹）吗？
——是的，她是我的姑姑。
questions.explanation: father's sister意为父亲的姐妹，即aunt（姑姑）。故选 aunt。

questions.prompt: 5. Alice and I are in the ______ picture.
questions.translation: 爱丽丝和我在下一张照片里。
questions.explanation: the next picture意为“下一张照片”。故选 next。

sections.title: 三、选词填空
sections.instruction: 从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳答案填入空白处。

questions.translation: 那些是我的祖父母。
questions.explanation: be动词为are，主语指示代词需用复数Those。句首首字母大写。故选 Those。

questions.translation: 托尼，辛迪是你的姑姑吗？
questions.explanation: 主语Cindy为第三人称单数，一般疑问句be动词用Is。句首首字母大写。故选 Is。

questions.prompt: 3. ______ is my sister. Her name is Mary.
questions.translation: 她是我的妹妹。她的名字叫玛丽。
questions.explanation: 句子缺少主语，应用第三人称女性代词主格She。句首首字母大写。故选 She。

questions.prompt:
4. —Are these your ______?
—Yes. They are very beautiful.
questions.translation:
——这些是你的照片吗？
——是的。它们非常漂亮。
questions.explanation: these修饰可数名词复数，photo的复数形式直接加s为photos。故选 photos。

questions.prompt: 5. This is my uncle. ______ last name is Green.
questions.translation: 这是我的叔叔。他的姓氏是格林。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词短语last name应用男性形容词性物主代词His。句首首字母大写。故选 His。

sections.title: 四、完形填空
sections.instruction: 通读短文，从每小题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
My name is Lily. I'm a student in No. 1 Middle School.

Look! Here [1] three pictures of mine. Mona is in the first [2]. She's my aunt's daughter. So she's my [3]. She's in my school, too. Are these [4] rulers? No, they aren't. They are mine. Here is [5] boy in the next picture. He's Dennis. He has a(n) [6]. Lucky is the name of his dog. It's brown. He likes playing games with it. [7] is the girl in the third picture? She's Nina. Nina is a nice girl. She isn't in my [8]. She's in PEP Middle School. Is [9] my cousin, too? [10], she is. She's Mona's sister.

questions.translation: 看！这里有我的三张照片。
questions.explanation: 倒装句主语three pictures of mine为复数，be动词用are。故选 are。

questions.translation: 莫娜在第一张照片里。
questions.explanation: 呼应上文three pictures，in the first picture意为“在第一张照片里”。故选 picture。

questions.translation: 所以她是我的堂妹。
questions.explanation: aunt's daughter（姑姑/姨母的女儿）是cousin（堂表姐妹）。故选 cousin。

questions.translation: 这些是她的直尺吗？不，不是。它们是我的。
questions.explanation: 提问是否为Mona（女性）的物品，修饰rulers用代词her。故选 her。

questions.translation: 下一张照片里有一个男孩。
questions.explanation: boy为单数可数名词，且以辅音音素开头，表示“一个”用不定冠词a。故选 a。

questions.translation: 他有一只狗。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“Lucky is the name of his dog.”可知他有一只狗（dog）。故选 dog。

questions.translation: 第三张照片里的女孩是谁？
questions.explanation: 根据答句“She's Nina.”可知询问人物身份，疑问词用Who。句首首字母大写。故选 Who。

questions.translation: 她不在我的学校。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“She's in PEP Middle School.”可知此处指不在同一个学校（school）。故选 school。

questions.translation: 她也是我的堂妹吗？
questions.explanation: 指代上文提到的女孩Nina，主格代词用she。故选 she。

questions.translation: 是的，她是。她是莫娜的妹妹。
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“She's Mona's sister.”（也是姑姑的女儿）可知作肯定回答Yes, she is。故选 Yes。

sections.title: 五、语篇填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项填入空白处，使短文通顺完整。
sections.passage:
Hello, friends. I'm Zhang Liang, a student in Beijing No. 1 Middle School. I have a big [1] (family) and eight people are in it. Now come and see my family [2] (photo).

In the first photo, you can see six people. These [3] (be) my paternal (父系的) grandparents, Zhang Junlin and Li Wenxiu. This is my mother. [4] (she) name is Wu Wan. She is a Chinese teacher in [5] (I) school. This is my father, Zhang Ruiwen. He is a doctor. He is very busy, but he [6] (read) book with me in the evening. [7] is the girl? She is my sister Zhang Yao. She is 25. She is very nice to me and helps me [8] my English every day.

In the next photo are my maternal (母系的) grandparents, Wu Lihong and Zhao Ling. They are [9] Shanghai. I always visit [10] (they) during the vacation and have a good time in Shanghai.

questions.translation: 我有一个大家庭，里面有八口人。
questions.explanation: a big family意为“一个大家庭”，用可数名词单数family。故选 family。

questions.translation: 现在来看看我的全家福照片吧。
questions.explanation: 根据后文“In the first photo... In the next photo...”可知不止一张照片，需用复数形式photos。故选 photos。

questions.translation: 这些是我的祖父母……
questions.explanation: 主语These为复数，be动词用are。故选 are。

questions.translation: 她的名字叫吴婉。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词name应用女性形容词性物主代词Her。句首首字母大写。故选 Her。

questions.translation: 她是我学校的一名语文老师。
questions.explanation: 修饰名词school应用第一人称形容词性物主代词my。故选 my。

questions.translation: 但他晚上会和我一起读书。
questions.explanation: 主语he为第三人称单数，叙述常态用一般现在时，动词read变三单形式reads。故选 reads。

questions.translation: 那个女孩是谁？她是我的姐姐张瑶。
questions.explanation: 根据答句“She is my sister...”可知提问人物身份用疑问词Who。句首首字母大写。故选 Who。

questions.translation: ……每天帮我学英语。
questions.explanation: help sb. with sth.为固定短语，意为“在某方面帮助某人”。故选 with。

questions.translation: 他们都在上海。
questions.explanation: 表示在上海大城市，介词用in，be in Shanghai意为“在上海”。故选 in。

questions.translation: 我总是在假期拜访他们……
questions.explanation: 动词visit后接人称代词宾格形式them。故选 them。

sections.title: 六、回答问题 (任务型阅读)
sections.instruction: 根据两张学生卡片的信息，从每小题所给的四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
| Student Card | Student Card |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Chinese name:** Zhang Xiaohe | **First name:** Kate |
| **English name:** Rose | **Last name:** Black |
| **School name:** Yucai Middle School, Shanghai | **Class:** Six |
| **Grade:** Seven | **Grade:** Eight |
| **Class:** One | **School:** Sun Middle School, England |
| **Father's name:** Zhang Kai | **Father's name:** Alan Black |
| **Mother's name:** Tang Caiyun | **Mother's name:** Susan Black |
| **Telephone number:** 021-4211062 | **English teacher's name:** Sally Read |

questions.translation: 罗斯是中国人还是英国人？
questions.explanation: 根据左侧卡片“Chinese name: Zhang Xiaohe, English name: Rose, School name: Yucai Middle School, Shanghai”可知Rose是中国人。故选 She is Chinese.。

questions.translation: 张小荷的电话号码是多少？
questions.explanation: 根据左侧卡片“Telephone number: 021-4211062”可知电话号码为021-4211062。故选 021-4211062.。

questions.prompt: 3. Who is an English teacher, Sally, Alan or Susan?
questions.translation: 谁是英语老师，萨莉、艾伦还是苏珊？
questions.explanation: 根据右侧卡片“English teacher's name: Sally Read”可知英语老师是Sally。故选 Sally.。

questions.translation: 凯特的姓氏是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据右侧卡片“Last name: Black”可知family name（姓氏）是Black。故选 Black.。

questions.translation: 罗斯在哪个班级？
questions.explanation: 根据左侧卡片“Grade: Seven, Class: One”可知她在Class One（一班）。故选 She is in Class One.。

sections.title: 七、阅读填空 (阅读还原)
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容，从短文后的选项中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有一项为多余选项。
sections.passage:
No matter who you are or where you live, the most important thing is what kind of person you are. [1] Among them, the following four ways are the most helpful ones.

**Be active.**
Life is not always a bed of roses. [2] Do you know what can help you overcome difficulties? Cheer up! Life is like a mirror. When you smile at it, it will also smile at you.

**Keep learning.**
Maybe you are very busy now. [3] However, the world around you is changing all the time. Don't think you are better than others, or you will fall behind others. Keeping learning can help you succeed in the future.

**Be creative.**
In modern society, people with creative thinking are mostly needed. [4]

**Be honest.**
Honesty is very important. Everyone likes the person who tells the truth. The one who keeps his words is popular everywhere.

As long as you have these ways mentioned above, [5] Try not to become a man of success, but rather try to become a man of value.
wordbank: you need to find time to exercise more.
When facing difficulties, don't lose heart.
you will be excellent and make a difference to the world.
There are many good ways that can make you better in your life.
Every day you have so many things to do that you can't find any time to study.
For example, if you come up with new ideas, you will have more choices in your life.

questions.translation: 有许多好的方法可以让你在生活中变得更好。
questions.explanation: 后句“Among them, the following four ways...”中的them指代前文提到的ways，选项D“There are many good ways that can make you better in your life”引出下文的四个方法。故选 D。

questions.translation: 面对困难时，不要灰心。
questions.explanation: 前句指出生活不总是一帆风顺，后句讲如何克服困难，选项B“When facing difficulties, don't lose heart”起承上启下作用。故选 B。

questions.translation: 每天你有那么多事情要做，以至于找不到任何时间学习。
questions.explanation: 前句“Maybe you are very busy now”与选项E“Every day you have so many things to do that you can't find any time to study”语义连贯，且与后文However转折衔接。故选 E。

questions.translation: 例如，如果你提出新想法，你在生活中就会有更多选择。
questions.explanation: 段落主题为“Be creative”，选项F通过举例“come up with new ideas”具体阐述创造性思维的作用。故选 F。

questions.translation: 你就会变得出类拔萃，并对世界产生影响。
questions.explanation: 与前句“As long as you have these ways mentioned above”构成条件句结果，选项C“you will be excellent and make a difference to the world”符合文意。故选 C。
